BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Floor Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Floor Finishes.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Floor Finishes.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Floor Finishes.

2. When learning Building Construction Project Phase 11, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Building Construction Project Phase 11.

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Speaker
   C. CPU
   D. Keyboard

8. When learning Pre-cast Concrete Products, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-cast Concrete Products.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. When learning Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Drawing.

12. When learning Building Material Schedules, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Material Schedules.

   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team

15. When learning Ceilings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Ignore burnt cables

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Ceilings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Fixings and Fittings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
